title: Zimbardo's Stanford Prison Experiment

tellings.quote: And Philip Zimbardo at Stanford with the Stanford Prison Experiment, like all very similar.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels mentions a psychologist named Philip Zimbardo and his Stanford Prison Experiment, a 1971 study at Stanford University in California in which students were made to act as prison guards and prisoners. Michels groups it with other programmes he is discussing and calls them "all very similar", in an episode about a secret society he links to the hiding of UFO information, though he doesn't spell out exactly what the likeness is.
